'''Colium''' was a substance used in conjunction with [[Girondium/Legends|girondium]] in ultra-high efficiency solar cells on [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]].
